carousel.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans globally are watching whether the BCCI's promised scheduling changes will better protect player welfare ahead of high-stakes overseas tours.

carousel.title: Indian Startup Funding Rebounds to $955 Million in August, Led by EV and Fintech
carousel.excerpt: Startup funding jumped 44% from July's lows, with River Mobility, Navi, and Yulu leading growth-stage deals while early-stage ventures captured 42% of total capital.
carousel.image_caption: Indian startup funding rebounded to $955 million in August 2026, led by investments in electric vehicle and fintech companies.
carousel.nri_angle: For Indian tech diaspora founders and investors who straddle Silicon Valley and Bengaluru, the data points to a market that rewards both established scale-ups and early-stage ventures in emerging sectors.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Zerodha Enters Investment Banking After SEBI Grants Merchant Banking Licence
carousel.excerpt: India's largest discount broker will focus on equity IPOs for new-age businesses through its newly approved subsidiary, Zerodha Corporate Advisors.
carousel.image_caption: Nithin Kamath, founder and CEO of Zerodha, which has received SEBI approval to enter investment banking through a new merchant banking licence.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors who trade through Zerodha may see expanded IPO access as the platform moves into investment banking.
